name: Corporate Action Price 96
definition: Specifies various prices of a corporate action.

MaximumPrice.name: Maximum Price
MaximumPrice.definition: Maximum or cap price at which a holder can bid, for example, on a Dutch auction offer.

MinimumPrice.name: Minimum Price
MinimumPrice.definition: Minimum or floor price at which a holder can bid, for example, on a Dutch auction offer.

FirstBidIncrementPrice.name: First Bid Increment Price
FirstBidIncrementPrice.definition: First acceptable price after the Minimum Price at which a holder can bid, for example on a Dutch auction offer.

LastBidIncrementPrice.name: Last Bid Increment Price
LastBidIncrementPrice.definition: Last acceptable price before the Maximum Price at which a holder can bid, for example on a Dutch auction offer.
